title: dimensions expectations
description: Editor aid for expectations.json: how many contexts each filter must select. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that nodes and roots exist, that each where name is a dimension, state group or shared node of the node with one of its values, and that each count matches, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

title.description: What the expectation says, shown when it fails.

node.description: The node whose contexts are counted.

subtree.description: Count the contexts of every node in the node's subtree.

root.description: Count only in this root; without it, in every root that contains the node.

where.description: Dimension, state group or shared node -> the value to keep.

count.description: How many contexts the filter must select.
